units.source_text: 我今夜须赴一品公主处，明日在宫中开始祈祷，七天期满退出之后，再与你授戒可也。”

en.t: I must go tonight to the First-Rank Princess, and tomorrow I will begin prayers in the palace; after the seven-day period is complete and I withdraw, I can give you the precepts.

units.source_text: 浮舟一想，如果那时妹尼僧已回家，势必阻止她出家，这就遗憾无穷了。

en.t: Ukifune thought that if the younger nun had returned home by then, she would surely stop her from taking vows, and that would leave endless regret.

units.source_text: 她因心情非常恶劣，定欲立刻出家，便再度请求：

en.t: Because she was in such anguish, she was determined to become a nun at once, and so she pleaded again:

units.source_text: “我非常痛苦。

en.t: I am in terrible pain.

units.source_text: 如果以后病势日重，即使受戒亦恐无效了。

en.t: If my illness grows worse day by day after this, I fear that even receiving the precepts will no longer help.

units.source_text: 且喜今日拜见，正是绝好机会。”

en.t: I am grateful to have met you today; this is the perfect opportunity.

units.source_text: 僧都慈悲为心，很可怜她，答道：

en.t: The bishop, moved by compassion and feeling great pity for her, replied:

units.source_text: “夜已很深了。

en.t: The night is already very late.

units.source_text: 我从山上下来，从前年轻时不当一回事。

en.t: I have come down from the mountain; when I was young, I would not have thought anything of it.

units.source_text: 现在年纪渐老，实在不堪其劳，正想略微休息一下，再进宫去。

en.t: Now that I am growing old, the fatigue is truly hard to bear, and I was just thinking of resting a little before going on to the palace.

units.source_text: 但你既如此性急，我就今夜与你授戒吧。”

en.t: But since you are so impatient, I will give you the precepts tonight.

units.source_text: 浮舟不胜欣喜，便取一把剪刀，放在梳栉箱的盖子里，呈送出来。

en.t: Ukifune was overjoyed; she took a pair of scissors, placed them on the lid of her comb box, and sent them out.

units.source_text: 僧都叫道：

en.t: The bishop called out:

units.source_text: “来，法师们到这里来！”

en.t: Come, monks, come over here!

units.source_text: 最初在宇治找到浮舟的两个和尚，今天跟僧都同来这里。

en.t: The two monks who had first found Ukifune at Uji had come here today with the bishop.

units.source_text: 僧都叫进来的便是这两人。

en.t: These were the two men whom the bishop called in.

units.source_text: 他对其中一个阿阇梨说：

en.t: He said to one of the ajari:

units.source_text: “请你给小姐落发吧。”

en.t: Please cut the young lady's hair for her.

units.source_text: 这阿阇梨想道：

en.t: This ajari thought to himself:

units.source_text: “此人的确身世飘零，在这世间做俗家人定多痛苦。”

en.t: This person has truly drifted through a troubled life; if she remains a layperson in this world, she will surely suffer much.

units.source_text: 他认为她应该出家。

en.t: He thought that she ought to become a nun.

units.source_text: 浮舟把头发从帷屏垂布的隙缝里送出来。

en.t: Ukifune pushed her hair out through a gap in the hanging cloth of the screen.

units.source_text: 这头发非常美丽可爱，因此阿阇梨拿着剪刀，一时不忍下手。

en.t: Her hair was so beautiful and lovely that the ajari, holding the scissors, could not bring himself to cut it at once.
